ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There is a circle in the figure, and point D is marked inside the circle as the center; line segment DE connects from D to point E on the circle, therefore DE is a radius. Point X is on the left side of the circle, line segment XE is drawn from X to point E on the circle, and there is a right-angle mark at E, indicating that DE is perpendicular to XE. A horizontal line passes from X to the right through the circle, first passing through the left-side intersection point Q of the circle, then through the center D, and finally reaches the right-side point T. Reasoning: Because DE is perpendicular to tangent XE, triangle XED is a right triangle, where EX=24, DE=7. By the Pythagorean theorem, XD=sqrt(24^2+7^2)=sqrt(576+49)=sqrt(625)=25. Q is on XD and DQ is a radius of the circle, so DQ=DE=7. Therefore QX=XD-DQ=25-7=18.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as showing X outside the circle, with XE tangent to the circle at E and the horizontal line from X cutting the circle at Q and T through the center D. From the text, EX=24 and DE=7, so the circle radius is 7 and the diameter QT is 14. Let QX=x. Since the secant goes through the whole diameter, XT=x+14. Use the tangent-secant power theorem from external point X: XE^2=XQ·XT. Thus 24^2=x(x+14). Solve x^2+14x-576=0, giving x=18 as the positive length. Therefore QX=18.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左侧有点 X，从 X 向右画出一条水平线穿过圆心 D，并与圆相交于左侧点 Q 和右侧点 T；另外还有两条从 X 出发的斜线分别在圆的上方 A 点和下方 E 点与圆相切，图中在 A、E 处都有直角标记，说明 DA ⟂ XA、DE ⟂ XE。题目给出 EX = 24，DE = 7。

再推理：因为 D 是圆心，所以 DE 是半径，半径为 7，因此直径 QT = 14。设 QX = x，则整个割线 XT = x + 14。由外点 X 的切割线定理（切线-割线幂定理），有
XE^2 = XQ · XT。
代入得到 24^2 = x(x + 14)，即 x^2 + 14x - 576 = 0。
因式分解或用公式得 x = 18 或 x = -32，长度取正值，所以 QX = 18。
